current_runtime.description: The configuration the repository currently treats as canonical. This is NOT the configuration any frozen evidence version was evaluated with; see latest_frozen_evidence_version and canonical_changes_since_latest_frozen_evidence.

canonical_changes_since_latest_frozen_ev.claim_boundary: P1.6 / Issue #17. 0.95 is the lowest tested safe positive-similarity fragment-exclusion threshold over the four frozen development sequences (deterministic 0.95-1.01 sweep, all annotated-ID/spatial/absent-output gates PASS, repeatable). Development-only; no absolute-performance, tracker-independent, or held-out claim.

P1.7 / Issue #18. 247 is the largest tested finite maximum age that exercised committed-prototype expiry with zero annotated-ID or spatial safety degradation over the four frozen development sequences (age sweep 62/93/247/394/427, repeatable). Development-only. Appearance vectors remain full-strength; expiry only during uninterrupted trusted LOCKED->LOCKED continuity.

Behaviour-neutral. Makes the pre-existing encode-all appearance-request default an explicit parameter so controlled Issue #44 experiments can override it with geometry_winner. No change to the canonical decision path.

canonical_changes_since_latest_frozen_ev.change: wide, unclipped crops may provide current comparison evidence without becoming eligible for trusted positive-memory updates
canonical_changes_since_latest_frozen_ev.claim_boundary: Issue #89. Reviewed development and live/simple-scene acceptance evidence promoted the separation between appearance encoding/comparison eligibility and positive-memory-update eligibility. The canonical crop-width threshold itself was not relaxed. Development/live acceptance only; no H01-H03 outcome was accessed. Reviewed result: docs/results/selected_target_tracking/p089_wide_crop_reacquisition.md.

canonical_changes_since_latest_frozen_ev.change: global_reacquisition_enabled false -> true; global_reacquisition_after_missed_frames retained at 9
canonical_changes_since_latest_frozen_ev.claim_boundary: Issue #90. Long-gap protected-identity global appearance reacquisition was promoted after controlled development-only comparison. The absolute appearance threshold remained 0.78 and no threshold tuning was performed. H01-H03 outcomes were not accessed. Reviewed result: docs/results/selected_target_tracking/p090_long_gap_global_reacquisition.md.

evidence_versions.claim_boundary: Clean P0.4 within-tracker comparisons reject safety portability of one preset across ByteTrack, SORT, OC-SORT, and DeepSORT. They do not rank trackers absolutely.
Structural hard-negative lifecycle evidence and four-sequence behavioral preservation only; no new universal performance or held-out claim.
Rank-aware confirmation composition passed focused tests and preserved the four recorded development outcomes; it is not a new absolute-performance claim.

evidence_versions.configuration_role: frozen development configuration with freshness and same-ID hijack protection; latest evidence version for the headline development claim, but superseded as the canonical runtime by the parameter promotions in current_runtime.canonical_changes_since_latest_frozen_evidence
evidence_versions.claim_boundary: Four-sequence development evidence shows improvement over raw under spatial and annotated-ID oracles. Spatial wrong is 0.000 s and strict annotated-ID wrong is 1.300 s; no flawless, tracker-independent, or held-out claim is supported.
